pages.text: A group of children were living in a untidy place and they wanted to improve the living condition. They wanted to clean their surroundings and started to clean that place , at that time a dog came and started barking on them. But the children din't want to leave and continued cleaning for better health and improve their skills in cleaning and decorating. Moral of the story is: Children are thoughtful on living conditions and having skills of cleaning and decorating
